claim: The Production front for the bare noun reads like the Lesson 17 verb card, and unlike its neighbours ダウンロード and べんきょう it has no 'the noun' hint, so I answer チェックします.
evidence: Production front: 'Travel & Tourism / Check / looking something over, not a bill'. Answer: チェック. Earlier card chapter-17/chekku-shimasu-2: チェックします | 'To check'. This deck glosses verbs bare too ('Make', 'Finish', 'Prepare'). Compare download-loanword: 'Download / the noun'.
fix: Add 'the noun' to the hint, as download-loanword and benkyou-study do.

claim: The note says only 3 voices かい to がい, but the deck has already taught me なんがい for 'what floor', which voices too.
evidence: Note: 'Only 3 voices it to がい; the other numbers keep かい.' Earlier cards: chapter-5-extras/which-floor なんがいですか | 'Which floor?'; chapter-5-extras/fib-reizouko-nangai れいぞうこはなんがいですか | 'What floor is the refrigerator on?'.
fix: Say 'Of the numbers, only 3 voices it (さんがい); the question word is なんがい too.'

claim: The English is nearly the same as the Lesson 18 card for いまよろしいですか, and nothing on the front tells me to use いい rather than よろしい.
evidence: Production front: 'Is now a good time to talk? / Asked over the phone, checking whether the other person is free to talk right now.' Answer: いまいいですか. Earlier card chapter-18-extras/yoroshii-ima: いまよろしいですか | 'Is now a good time?'.
fix: Add a cue to the hint such as 'everyday form, with いい rather than the politer よろしい'.

claim: A one-word front 'Clean' also fits きれい, which I learned as 'Pretty, beautiful, clean'.
evidence: Production front: 'Home & Household / Clean'. Answer: そうじをします. Earlier card chapter-10/kirei: きれい | 'Pretty, beautiful, clean'.
fix: Gloss it as a verb phrase, e.g. 'Clean (do the cleaning)'.

claim: The note talks about an '(R2)' label that is not on the card and is in a book I don't have, so it tells me nothing.
evidence: Note on both faces: '(R2) marks its conjugation class in the book.' Nothing on either face shows '(R2)'.

claim: The only note that explains ています says it is for an action happening right now, but the extras use it for lessons taken every week and jogging done sometimes, which that rule does not cover.
evidence: Note: 'The ています form ... for an action happening right now.' Extras: kato-guitar-weekly 'かとうさんはまいしゅうギターをならっています' = 'Kato-san takes guitar lessons every week.'; jogging-o-shimasu-1 'スミスさんはときどきジョギングをしています' = 'Smith-san sometimes goes jogging.'
fix: Add one sentence: ています also describes something ongoing over a period, such as lessons you are taking these days.

claim: Several notes point to other cards as 'above' or 'below', which means nothing when cards come shuffled.
evidence: madadesu-not-yet: 'a もう〜ましたか question ... above'; mou-already: 'answered with まだです below'; mousugu-soon and mou-sukoshi: 'もう ("already") above'; tsukuru-dict-form, dekiru-dict-form, owaru-dict-form, yoyaku-suru-dict-form: '... above'.
fix: Drop 'above' and 'below'; the notes already name the word they mean.

claim: 'Sometimes goes jogging' is a habit, and every habit I have been taught, including one in this same unit, uses the plain ます form, so nothing on the front tells me to say しています.
evidence: Production front: 'Smith-san sometimes goes jogging.' Answer: スミスさんはときどきジョギングをしています. Same unit, undou-o-shimasu-1: スミスさんはまいあさうんどうをします | 'Smith-san exercises every morning.' Earlier card chapter-9-extras/p9-tokidoki-gorufu-o-shimasu-ka: かとうさんはときどきゴルフをしますか | 'Does Kato-san sometimes play golf?'.
fix: Either make the target ジョギングをします, or change the English and add a hint so the ています form is asked for (for example 'Smith-san has been jogging now and then (ています form)').

claim: Lesson 17 taught me to check something with を + チェックします, so I answer レポートをチェックします and the card wants レポートのチェックをします.
evidence: Production front: 'I will check the report.' Answer: レポートのチェックをします. Earlier cards: chapter-17-extras/before-work-check-news ...ニュースをチェックします | 'checks the news'; chapter-17-extras/suzuki-before-email-checked-address ...メールアドレスをチェックしました; this unit's check-noun note: 'combined directly with します (チェックします, no を)'.
fix: Add a hint naming the pattern ('using the noun チェック: X の チェック を します'), or a note saying both forms work and this card practises the の form.

claim: 'Please check over the materials' fits the てください request I already know as well as the おねがいします form the card wants.
evidence: Production front: 'Please check over the materials.' Answer: しりょうのチェックをおねがいします. Known: チェックします (chapter-17), the てください request pattern (chapter-19, e.g. 'しょるいをとどけてください').
fix: Add a hint such as 'asking with おねがいします'.

claim: This unit leans on 'X の [noun] を します' (プロジェクトのせつめいをします, パーティーのじゅんびをします) and no card says that the thing being explained or prepared goes in front with の.
evidence: Production front: 'Smith-san is explaining the project.' Answer: スミスさんはプロジェクトのせつめいをしています. Base card setsumei-shimasu-explain: せつめいをします | 'Explain', no note. Same pattern in setsumei-shimasu-explain-1, explaining-project-not-materials, emma-explaining-product, ashita-party-junbi, presenting-prep-wait, report-check-shimasu, check-noun-1.
fix: Add a note to this card (or to setsumei-shimasu-explain): with a noun + を します verb, the object goes before the noun with の, as in プロジェクトの せつめいを します.

claim: The sentence ends in でんわします, but every earlier card says でんわをします, so I would answer with を.
evidence: Answer: レストランをよやくするまえに、でんわします. Earlier: chapter-9 でんわをします | 'Telephone (someone)'; chapter-17-extras えきにいくまえに、ともだちにでんわをします.
fix: Use でんわをします, as the rest of the deck does.

claim: 'Hello, this is Tanaka.' is the same English as a Lesson 6 phone card whose answer was はい + name.
